name: DeDop Studio 1.5.1
body:
Changes in this version:
- New electron 1.8.8
- Fix issue #4 (Some buttons have wrong font-colors)

name: DeDop Studio 1.4.0
body:
Changes in this version:
- New dependencies versions:
  - React 16.2.0
  - Electron 1.8.2
  - Cesium 1.27.0
- MacOS installers are now signed
- Now depends on **DeDop Core version >=1.4.0,<1.5.0**
- Improved error message when DeDop Core is not yet installed

name: DeDop Studio 1.3.0
body: The only change in this release is a different DeDop Core version requirement. It is compatible with **version >=1.3.0,<1.4.0**.

name: DeDop Studio 1.2.0
body:
Changes: 
* Adapted to allow creating a default config for Adapted Cryosat-2 FBR data
* Bug fix #5 
* AppImage installer is now built with category #3 
* Code editor for configuration editing now uses [React-Ace](https://github.com/securingsincity/react-ace).

name: DeDop Studio 1.1.0
body: This version allows the use of DeDop-core v1.0.0 or v1.1.0.

name: DeDop Studio 1.0.0
body: First release. Instruction on how to install: https://github.com/DeDop/dedop-installer
